s = {1, 2, 3}
t = s.copy()
t.add(4)
s.discard(10)
print(s, t, s < t)

questions.q: Duty cycling in battery-powered wireless sensor nodes is mainly used to:
options: Save energy by periodically putting the radio to sleep
Select the shortest route to the sink
questions.exp: The radio is the major energy consumer, so nodes sleep for most of the time.

questions.q: Dijkstra's algorithm with a binary min-heap on a graph with V vertices and E edges runs in time

questions.q: Match the system with its category: (i) VxWorks (ii) MS-DOS (iii) UNIX. Which mapping is correct?
options: (i) single-user OS, (ii) multi-user OS, (iii) real-time OS
(i) Real-time OS, (ii) single-user single-tasking OS, (iii) multi-user multitasking OS
(i) real-time OS, (ii) multi-user OS, (iii) single-user OS
(i) multi-user OS, (ii) real-time OS, (iii) single-user OS
questions.exp: VxWorks is an RTOS, MS-DOS ran one task at a time for one user, and UNIX supports many users and processes.

questions.exp: Leaves = n - floor(n/2) = 25 - 12 = 13.

questions.exp: All capitals is read as shouting in online communication.

questions.exp: C → B violates BCNF (C is not a superkey). Splitting into (C, B) and (A, C) is lossless since C is a key of (C, B), and (A, C) is in BCNF.

questions.q: Legal recognition to electronic records under the IT Act 2000 is given in Section

questions.q: Objects created with the new operator in Java are allocated in the:

questions.q: What happens when an existing text file is opened with open('notes.txt', 'w')?
options: The new text is added at the end

questions.q:

print(type(()), type({}), type({1}), type(None).__name__, isinstance(True, int))

questions.exp: Single precision has 1 sign bit, 8 exponent bits and 23 fraction bits.

questions.q:
Match the OSI layer with its function.
P. Physical  Q. Data link  R. Network  S. Transport
1. Process-to-process delivery  2. Hop-to-hop frame delivery using MAC addresses  3. Host-to-host routing  4. Transmission of raw bits
questions.exp: Physical sends bits, data link delivers frames hop to hop, network routes host to host and transport gives process-to-process delivery.

questions.q: Classes B and C both derive directly from class A. This type of inheritance is:
questions.exp: Several classes inheriting from one base form hierarchical inheritance.

questions.q: A decision tree algorithm such as ID3 chooses the attribute for splitting a node using

questions.q: To convert an SR flip-flop into a JK flip-flop, the inputs are connected as
questions.exp: Feeding back the outputs ensures S and R are never both 1, which gives JK behaviour.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): Digital signatures provide non-repudiation.
Reason (R): A digital signature is created with the signer's private key, which only the signer possesses.
options: Both Assertion and Reason are true, but Reason is not the correct explanation of Assertion
Assertion is true but Reason is false
Both Assertion and Reason are true, and Reason is the correct explanation of Assertion
Assertion is false but Reason is true

questions.q: In a star schema, the central table is the
options: lookup table that stores only text descriptions
fact table, surrounded by dimension tables
questions.exp: A star schema has a central fact table of measures and foreign keys linked to surrounding dimension tables.

questions.q: A PDA for {a^n b^n | n ≥ 1} pushes one symbol A on the stack for each a and pops one A for each b. After reading aaabb, how many A symbols are on the stack?
questions.exp: Three pushes and two pops leave 3 - 2 = 1 symbol A.

questions.q: An NFA over {a,b} has states p (start), q, r with r final. p-a->{p,q}, p-b->{p}, q-b->{r}, and there are no other transitions. How many states (excluding the empty set) does the subset construction produce?
questions.exp: Reachable subsets: {p}; on a {p,q}; from {p,q} on a {p,q}, on b {p,r}; from {p,r} on a {p,q}, on b {p}. Total 3.

questions.q: A friend function of a C++ class:
options: Is a member function of the class
Is not a member of the class but can access its private members
questions.exp: Friendship grants access to private and protected members without making the function a member; it is not inherited.

questions.q: Which statement about Ethereum smart contracts is correct?
options: They are self-executing programs stored and run on the blockchain
They are paper agreements digitally scanned
They can be altered by one administrator at any time
questions.exp: A smart contract's code executes automatically when conditions are met and is stored on-chain.

questions.q: Which of the following 8085 instructions does NOT affect any flag?
questions.exp: INX (16-bit increment) leaves all flags unchanged, whereas ADD, INR and ANA modify flags.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a field in the UDP header?
questions.exp: The UDP header has source port, destination port, length and checksum; it has no sequence number.

questions.q: A page fault occurs when:
options: a process accesses a page that is not currently in main memory
a page is replaced using the LRU algorithm
the CPU runs out of registers
two processes access the same page
questions.exp: A page fault is raised when the referenced page is not present in a frame; the OS then loads it from disk.

questions.q:
Match each language with the smallest class containing it.

questions.q: A foreign key column in a child table
options: can contain only values present in the parent key, or NULL
must be declared as the primary key of the child

questions.q:

A is true and R is false

questions.q: Which of the following is a requirement for creating an immutable class in Java?
options: Declare fields private and final and provide no setters
Provide public setters for all fields

questions.exp: This is the defining invariant of the algorithm.

questions.q: The Apriori principle in association rule mining says that

if an itemset is frequent, all supersets are frequent
every itemset has the same support
confidence is always greater than support

questions.q:

Which option is correct?
options: Statement I is true and Statement II is false
Statement I is false and Statement II is true

questions.q: Brooks' law states that

Every program contains at least one defect per 1000 lines

questions.q: In a microkernel design:

questions.q:

questions.exp: Gandhi's first satyagraha in India was for peasants forced to grow indigo on 3/20 of their land.

questions.q: Who appoints the Governor of a state in India?
questions.exp: Under Article 155, the Governor is appointed by the President by warrant under his hand and seal.

questions.q: India's first satellite, Aryabhata, was launched in which year?
questions.exp: Aryabhata was launched on 19 April 1975 with Soviet help.

questions.q: Forests act as carbon sinks because they
options: Absorb CO2 during photosynthesis and store carbon in biomass
questions.exp: Trees fix atmospheric CO2 and store carbon in wood and soil.

questions.q: Species richness generally
options: Increases from the poles towards the equator
Increases from the equator to poles
Remains the same at all latitudes
questions.exp: Tropical regions have more stable climate and energy, supporting greater species diversity.

questions.q: Pneumatophores or breathing roots are characteristic of which ecosystem?
questions.exp: Mangroves growing in waterlogged saline mud have pneumatophores for gas exchange.

questions.q: The Biological Diversity Act of India was passed in
questions.exp: The Biological Diversity Act, 2002 led to creation of the National Biodiversity Authority (Chennai).

questions.q: The National Green Tribunal was established in India in
questions.exp: The NGT Act, 2010 created a specialised body for speedy disposal of environmental cases.

questions.q: A man walking at 5 km/h reaches his office 12 minutes late; walking at 6 km/h he is 6 minutes early. What is the distance to the office?
In a group of 100 people, 60 speak Hindi, 45 speak English and 20 speak both. How many speak exactly one of the two languages?
questions.exp: Only Hindi = 40, only English = 25; exactly one = 65.

questions.q: A chord 16 cm long is drawn in a circle of radius 10 cm. What is its distance from the centre?
questions.exp: Half-chord = 8; distance = √(10² - 8²) = 6 cm (perpendicular from centre bisects the chord).

questions.q: If 2x + 3y = 12 and x - y = 1, what is the value of y?
questions.exp: x = y + 1, so 2y + 2 + 3y = 12 gives y = 2 (and x = 3).

questions.q: A Class VI student says 0.35 is greater than 0.4 because 35 is greater than 4. What misconception does this show?
options: Treating the decimal digits as a whole number without regard to place value
Being unable to read numbers aloud
questions.exp: The student ignores place value after the decimal point; 0.35 = 35/100 < 40/100 = 0.4.

questions.q: A man walks 7 km north, then 8 km east, then 3 km west and then 5 km north. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.exp: Net displacement: 5 km east and 7 + 5 = 12 km north. Distance = √(5² + 12²) = 13 km.
The rule is a − b (equivalently two-thirds of a): 15 − 5 = 10.

questions.q: If the first day of a non-leap year is Monday, on which day will 31 December of that year fall?
questions.exp: A non-leap year has 52 weeks and 1 odd day, so the last day falls on the same weekday as the first day: Monday.

questions.q: In a survey of 100 people, 60 read the Hindi newspaper, 45 read the English newspaper and 20 read both. How many read exactly one of the two newspapers?
questions.exp: Only Hindi = 60 − 20 = 40 and only English = 45 − 20 = 25. Exactly one = 40 + 25 = 65.

questions.q:
Statements: All members of a club are adults. Some adults are chess players.
Conclusions: I. Some members are chess players. II. Some chess players are adults.
questions.exp: Some adults are chess players directly gives II. The chess-playing adults may not be club members, so I does not follow.
